sentences.text: for the petitioner This is an application under Section 24 of the Code of Civil Procedure seeking transfer of Matrimonial suit no. 524 of 2022 presently pending before the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah to the court of learned District Judge, South 24 parganas at Alipore.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: District Judge, South 24 parganas at Alipore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner contended that the petitioner was married with the opposite party on 7.3.2014 and they are blessed with a female child who is now staying with the petitioner.

The petitioner alleged that after marriage, opposite party started to ill treat her and subjected her to cruelty for demand of dowry and ultimately on 16.9.2022, she was driven out from her matrimonial home by the opposite party and her in-laws.
the petitioner has lodged a complaint to that extent in Bagnan Police Station under Section 498A/406 of the Indian Penal Code.

The petitioner submits that she is an unemployed lady and for which she has initiated a proceeding for maintenance for herself and her minor daughter under the provision of Section 125 of the Code of Criminal Procedure which is pending before the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Alipore.

entities.text: Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate at Alipore
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: The petitioner further submits that all of a sudden, the opposite party/husband has instituted aforesaid suit for restitution of conjugal rights which is now pending before the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah.

entities.text: Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: He further submits that the court at Uluberia situates at a distance of about 90 kilometres from her present place of residence in both ways and she is facing lot of difficulties in attending the said proceeding at Uluberia court along with her minor child.
Accordingly, the petitioner has sought for aforesaid transfer.

The petitioner is directed to serve a copy of the revisional application upon the opposite party by speed post with acknowledgment due with an intimation that the matter will appear under the heading "Hearing of Section 24 application" on 18th May, 2023 and to file affidavit of service on the returnable date.

Since the petitioner has made out an arguable case, let all further proceedings being Matrimonial suit no. 524 of 2022 presently pending before the court of learned Additional District Judge, 1st Court, Uluberia, Howrah be stayed for a period of eight weeks or until further order, whichever is earlier.
(Ajoy Kumar Mukherjee, J.)
